final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)') AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), qualifying AS (SELECT status, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_average FROM status_avgs CROSS JOIN overall WHERE avg_modindex > overall_avg) SELECT status, avg_modindex, above_average, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying
